content.short: Sentient is a decentralized AI platform developing open-source AGI models that are community-owned and monetizable.
content.description: Sentient is a pioneering decentralized AI network and Layer 1 blockchain designed to democratize access to Artificial General Intelligence (AGI). Co-founded by industry leaders including Sandeep Nailwal, the platform provides a secure and transparent framework for users to create, share, and monetize open-source AI models. Utilizing its proprietary 'OML' (Open, Monetizable, Loyal) framework, Sentient ensures that contributors are fairly rewarded and that AI development remains open. The network is powered by the $SENT token, which facilitates compute resource allocation.
content.meta: Sentient provides a decentralized Layer 1 network for community-owned and monetizable AI. Discover Sentient and more on the Lancers Web3 Explorer.
